items.question: Which ritual acts are included within the performance of Vedic twilight worship?
premises: Vedic twilight worship involves the giving of arghya.
The arghya offering is directed to the lord of the day.
Recitation of the Gāyatrī mantra is likewise performed.
items.inference: Therefore, offering arghya to the sun and reciting the Gāyatrī are constituent acts of Vedic twilight worship.
items.plain_english: Likewise, there is the giving of arghya to the sun and the recitation of the Gāyatrī.
